tool_input.command:
t=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$t/dest"
for s in 20260101-000000 20260102-000000 20260103-000000; do echo x > "$t/dest/demo-$s.tar.gz"; echo "deadbeef  demo-$s.tar.gz" > "$t/dest/demo-$s.tar.gz.sha256"; done
echo "--- rotate --keep=2 (=value form):"; bash rotate.sh --quiet --dest="$t/dest" --name=demo --keep=2
echo "--- files left:"; ls "$t/dest"
echo "--- dry-run at exactly keep:"; bash rotate.sh -q -n --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --keep 2; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- help exits 0:"; bash rotate.sh --help >/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"; bash verify.sh --help >/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- unknown option exits 1:"; bash verify.sh --dest "$t/dest" --bogus 2>/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- missing --dest exits 1:"; bash rotate.sh --name demo 2>/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- bad --keep exits 1:"; bash rotate.sh --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --keep x 2>/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
rm -rf "$t"
